name: SSO-OIDC Authentication
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and a full admin configuration UI.

versions.changelog: Fix: honor Jellyfin's Base URL setting in generated SSO links (login buttons, branding snippet, callback page) so they work behind a reverse-proxy base path. Feat: sign in native/mobile apps (Android, iOS/Swiftfin, Android TV) via a Quick Connect bridge, since the web login button doesn't reach them. Feat: sync the Jellyfin avatar from the IdP's picture claim on login, with a per-provider opt-out.

Fix: bind OIDC login flow to the initiating browser to close a login-CSRF gap (#8). Fix: block loopback/link-local Authority URLs by default, with an opt-in plugin-wide setting to also block RFC1918/ULA ranges (#9).

Feat: per-IP fixed-window rate limiting on OIDC auth endpoints. Fix: dead-code bug in ClaimParser where JSON array claim values were never parsed. CI: 77-test suite with AAA pattern coverage across all services and controllers.
Fix: role mappings added after a previous save were overwriting earlier ones. Rename plugin to SSO-OIDC Authentication.
